entities.name: Sláine mac Dela
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sláine, son of Dela, of the Fir Bolg was the legendary first High King of Ireland, who cleared the forest around Brú na Bóinne. He reportedly came ashore at Wexford Harbour at the mouth of the River Slaney.
